title: Export shows Not Tracked for an untracked part and has no status column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active tracked part, part A, with 6 in its default bin.
  • Have an active untracked part, part B, with 4 in its bin.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Use a computer that can open the exported file in a spreadsheet program.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Export.
  4. Open the downloaded file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • A file downloads.

Step 4:

  • In the quantity column, part B's row reads "Not Tracked" and part A's row reads 6.
  • The column headings include the part number and the quantity, and none of them is a status (no Status, Active or Inactive column).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
